# Copilot Instructions

This is a course repository for *Scientific Computing Methods for Engineering Design Optimization. The primary language is **Python* with *Jupyter notebooks*.

## Course Context

- *Primary textbook*: [Engineering Design Optimization by Martins & Ning](https://mdobook.github.io/)
- *Running example*: Hybrid-Electric Aircraft Design ([de Vries et al., AIAA 2026-4690](https://arc.aiaa.org/doi/abs/10.2514/6.2026-4690)) — used as a consistent motivating problem across topics
- *Topics covered* (not necessarily in sequence):
  1. Coding with agentic AI tools
  2. Design Structure Matrix (DSM)
  3. Iterative methods
  4. Gradient-based optimization methods
  5. Computing derivatives
  6. Gradient-free optimization methods
  7. Multi-objective optimization
  8. Surrogate-based optimization
  9. Optimization under uncertainty
  10. Multidisciplinary Design Optimization (MDO)

## Agentic Workflow

This repo uses a two-layer agentic approach:

*Layer 1 — Copilot Plan mode* (/plan): Use this to define high-level intent for a module before any work starts. 
E.g.: /plan Add a module on gradient-based optimization applied to aircraft range maximization


*Layer 2 — Squad agents* (copilot --agent squad --yolo)

*Typical task workflow:*

# 1. Set intent with plan mode
/plan <task or module description>

# 2. Initialize a fresh Squad workspace

*Squad setup*:
bash
npm install -g @bradygaster/squad-cli
squad init        # run from the repository root for every new task

Run `squad init` fresh for each task so Squad creates task-specific agents and
context. Do not reuse a prior task's Squad workspace.

All artifacts generated by `squad init` are local-only and must not be tracked
or committed. This includes `.squad/`, `.copilot/`, `.mcp.json`,
`.gitattributes`, the generated Squad agent, the named Squad skill directories
listed in `.gitignore`, and the generated `squad-*.yml` and
`sync-squad-labels.yml` workflows. Do not ignore or remove other
repository-owned `.github/skills/` directories. The repository `.gitignore`
enforces this policy.

# 3. Delegate to Squad

*Run squad:*
bash
copilot --agent squad --yolo
